items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] How did you happen to hire Papa Teal? ... [INTERVIEWEE] ... He buys the place, 101 Ranch. ... We played, played, played.

ctx.x: For me? No, I was piano. Pete Bocci was just playing violin. So, we started. On our first number that time, he said, well, right there, get that kicker down there. Well, I just want to acknowledge him that Silister had an experience. Well, he did out pretty nice, but he's nervous. Been along pretty good. Then, the second tune we played, The Flowers Blown in Springtime. Well, he could shine on that. Jack used to play it all the time. Everybody liked it. The girls came by the stairs. Sounds nice, nice, fine.…
How did you happen to hire Papa Teal?

Near the clarinet. George Field. See, I get Papa. See, I get Papa. George Field. We played and played and played. The arrangement was made. Randy. After Parker Brothers, John Daniels, John Daniels, Harry Brooks and Kit Harris. They were his friends from New York. They know each other as well. Well, they spoke at Harry Parker. He had his bartender at the 101 Ranch with Jew Morris. And a great friend to Billy Phillip. So, they said, Why don't you give Billy the preference? All right. Tell Billy about it. Jew Morris…
